body.prose:
What a URL may carry is what a chassis can be started with: a store to attach when it is not the default, a commit to pin a read to, and a mount to boot into; and beside them where one looks, as [beneath](ref:01M6M9PESFFV6N2XAT92ACXVD7). Opened on the bare domain, the client takes the store it ships with and the entry that store holds, and the URL stays empty.

*The bare domain the author's, 2026-11-01; the flags carried from OpenLight's chassis: `--at`, `--entry`, `--mount`.*
body.title: A URL is the chassis's flags
